ASSIGNMENT AND ASSUMPTION OF LEASE

This Assignment and Assumption of Lease (this "Assignment") is made and entered into as of March 2, 2026 (the "Effective Date"), by and between BRAMBLETON OPTICS LLC, a Virginia limited liability company ("Assignor"), and CORRIDOR DENTAL PARTNERS, PLLC, a Virginia professional limited liability company ("Assignee").

RECITALS

A. Assignor, as tenant, and LOUDOUN GATEWAY HOLDINGS, L.P., a Delaware limited partnership ("Landlord"), as landlord, entered into that certain Retail Lease dated August 14, 2021 (as amended by the First Amendment to Retail Lease dated May 3, 2023, the "Lease"), covering approximately 3,240 rentable square feet known as Suite 140, Brambleton Town Center, 22860 Brambleton Plaza, Ashburn, Virginia 20148 (the "Premises").

B. Assignor desires to assign all of its right, title, and interest as tenant under the Lease to Assignee, and Assignee desires to accept that assignment and assume Assignor's obligations under the Lease, on the terms set out below.

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants contained in this Assignment and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are acknowledged, the parties agree as follows:

1. Assignment. Effective as of the Effective Date, Assignor assigns, transfers, and conveys to Assignee all of Assignor's right, title, and interest in, to, and under the Lease, including the leasehold estate created by the Lease and Assignor's interest in the Security Deposit described in Section 4.

2. Assumption. Assignee accepts the assignment and assumes and agrees to perform all of the obligations of the tenant under the Lease arising from and after the Effective Date, including the payment of Base Rent, Additional Rent, and all other charges. Assignee agrees to be bound by every term of the Lease as if Assignee were the original tenant named in it.

3. Assignor's Retained Obligations. Assignor remains liable for all obligations of the tenant under the Lease that arose before the Effective Date, including unpaid Base Rent, Additional Rent, and any reconciliation of operating expenses for the period ending on the Effective Date.

4. Security Deposit. Landlord holds a Security Deposit of $18,500 under Section 5.3 of the Lease. Assignee has paid Assignor $18,500 on the Effective Date, and the Security Deposit is credited to Assignee's account with Landlord. Assignor has no further claim to the Security Deposit.

5. Landlord's Consent. This Assignment is conditioned on Landlord's written consent under Section 14.1 of the Lease. Landlord's consent is attached as Exhibit A. Nothing in this Assignment releases Assignor from liability to Landlord except to the extent Landlord expressly releases Assignor in that consent.

6. Assignor's Representations. Assignor represents and warrants to Assignee that: (a) the Lease is in full force and effect and is the entire agreement between Assignor and Landlord as to the Premises; (b) a true and complete copy of the Lease is attached as Exhibit B; (c) Assignor has not assigned, sublet, or encumbered its interest in the Lease; (d) to Assignor's knowledge, no default by Assignor or Landlord exists under the Lease and no event has occurred that with notice or the passage of time would be a default; and (e) Base Rent has been paid through February 28, 2026.

7. Assignee's Representations. Assignee represents and warrants to Assignor that Assignee has received and reviewed a copy of the Lease, has had the opportunity to inspect the Premises, and accepts the Premises in their AS-IS, WHERE-IS condition as of the Effective Date.

8. Indemnification. Assignor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Assignee from and against all claims, damages, liabilities, and reasonable attorneys' fees arising out of the tenant's obligations under the Lease accruing before the Effective Date. Assignee shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Assignor from and against all claims, damages, liabilities, and reasonable attorneys' fees arising out of the tenant's obligations under the Lease accruing on or after the Effective Date.

9. Broker. Each party represents that it has dealt with no broker in connection with this Assignment other than Keyes Commercial Advisors, whose commission is payable by Assignor under a separate agreement. Each party shall indemnify the other against any claim for a commission by any other broker claiming through the indemnifying party.

10. Notices. All notices under this Assignment shall be in writing and delivered by hand, by nationally recognized overnight courier, or by certified mail, return receipt requested, to the addresses stated beneath the parties' signatures, and shall be effective on receipt or refusal of receipt.

11. Governing Law. This Assignment is governed by the laws of the Commonwealth of Virginia, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules. Each party consents to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts sitting in Loudoun County, Virginia.

12. Miscellaneous. This Assignment binds and benefits the parties and their permitted successors and assigns. This Assignment may be executed in counterparts, including by electronic signature, each of which is an original and all of which together are one instrument. This Assignment is the entire agreement of the parties as to its subject matter and supersedes all prior negotiations. No amendment is effective unless in writing and signed by both parties.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Assignment as of the Effective Date.
